dependencies.reason: Compiler MMIO layouts feed saved-layout checks.
Saved inheritance consumes compiler and native producer references.
Packaged call-site checks reuse compiler cases and saved plans.
Failure mutants consume the producer failure baseline and fault shim.
Primary fixture, saved project, exports, validator index and report handoffs remain private to one group.
Formatter retention actions follow their owning test outcome.
Rebased/unavailable unwind checks reuse original and recovered frame outputs.
LLDB and installed unwind chooser consume conditioned compiler references.

isolation.projects: Private checkout, Ghidra installation, fixture and output tree per job; no project transfer between groups.
isolation.children: Nested lexical, static, object, register-copy and build-ID scenarios remain inside their original parent command.
isolation.performance: Keep warmups and alternating AB/BA pairs sequential in one dedicated x86 job.
isolation.setup: Every group needs harness classes explicitly compiled; original producer smoke tests run once per target. Pinned debugger/emulator setup must be supplied without removing any profile.
